cover.hook: Google's AI is citing social posts. Are yours worth citing?
cover.label: 5 AI + social updates worth knowing this week

slides.headline: of Google AI Overviews linked to a [[social platform]]
slides.sub: SE Ranking checked 100,000 keywords. ChatGPT linked to social in just 8.4% of answers.
slides.source: SE Ranking, via Social Media Today, Oct 7

slides.headline: Meta now sells [[3 to 24 hour ad windows]]
slides.sub: Ads Super Burst can lock rivals out of your category. First Impression Ads, a US test, gives one brand the first ad slot each day.
slides.source: Meta, via Social Media Today, Oct 15

slides.headline: Instagram Edits now builds [[carousels]]
slides.sub: Mix photos and video, reuse Edits fonts and text styles, and make custom stickers. On iOS now, Android soon.
slides.source: Instagram, via Social Media Today, Oct 7

slides.headline: Links in posts are here, but [[capped]]
slides.sub: Meta One Advanced, at $49.99 a month, adds links to organic posts and Reels. That covers 4 posts and 4 Reels a month. Even the $499 Max plan stops at 12 of each.

slides.headline: That ChatGPT traffic drop was mostly [[a tracking bug]]
slides.sub: ChatGPT links lost their UTM tags, so visits landed in Direct. One tracker saw ChatGPT visits fall 67%. A fix began rolling out Oct 15.

take.headline: Social is now a [[search channel]]
take.sub: Post things worth citing. Clear answers, real numbers, your name on it. Then watch who finds you.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.
